 Process Change Update Re Invoice Receiving Process  

 Dear all colleagues,
 Per your query last quarter and as discussed this year during budget workshops for various department, our procurement process undergo significant adjustments in invoice management practices.
 The main change we aim for are the standard invoice upload procedure, to now incorporate additional checks by department account officers prior receipt verification.

 Effective with 3 June this change applies as a formalized guideline, and departmental heads should inform your accounts payable officers as to this alteration in the procedure to prevent future confusion.
 The purpose being the enhancement our control processes to avoid financial irregularites.
 This transition is aimed ensuring a systematic review prior of receiving and entering invoice entries. Any concerns and additional insights on adapting are appreciated.
 Should have question arise during our process implementation please direct queries through your assigned liaison for further support

Thanking everyone

 Best 

John R
